definitions.gloss: daze; absent-mindedness; stupor; being beside oneself
definitions.explanation: A state of being so shocked, stunned, or overwhelmed that one loses awareness of one's surroundings. Most commonly appears in the set phrase 茫然自失.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He was in a daze, completely stunned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知|し}らせ→知らせ：03252_shirase⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Upon hearing news of the accident, she was struck dumb with shock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}い→失う：01887_ushinau⟧、⟦しばらく→しばらく：01267_shibaraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: After losing his home in the earthquake, he remained in a state of shock for some time.

notes:
Almost exclusively used in the four-character compound ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ} (stunned and dazed). Rarely appears on its own.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be in a daze)
- ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become dazed)
- ⟦{茫然|ぼうぜん}→茫然：09405_bouzen⟧{自失|じしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧ (a state of shock)

Literally means "losing oneself" — the {自|じ} (self) is {失|しつ} (lost). The word describes a temporary state of mental paralysis caused by shock or grief.
